block.create_transit.transit_gate.toolti: Handles _customs_ for arriving shipments, stripping _one transit label_ and merging a declared order back into a single delivery.
block.create_transit.transit_link.toolti: Declares a _border_ on this network. Every shipment it forwards is stamped with its _transit label_.
block.create_transit.transit_ticker.tool: Mounts a _second logistics network_ onto this one, so its _stock_ can serve requests made here.
create_transit.package_port.endpoint_off: The address is an ordinary local one
create_transit.package_port.endpoint_on: The address is a foreign package's transit label (blank = default lane, * = any)
create_transit.ponder.tag.transit.descri: Components which let freight cross between logistics networks
create_transit.ponder.transit_gate.heade: Crossing a border with the Transit Gate
create_transit.ponder.transit_gate.text_: The first label will be stripped off
A sign's label filters what comes in, and stamps what goes out
Given redstone power, the gate stamps its own label on the way out
The label extends to the gates beside it
create_transit.ponder.transit_gate_merge: Merging a shipment at the border
One request can be packed in more than one place
A transit shipment only passes the gate once every part has arrived
create_transit.ponder.transit_link.heade: Declaring a border with the Transit Link
create_transit.ponder.transit_link.text_: Transit Links are Stock Links that also declare a border
Right-click the link to write its transit label
Full redstone power will stop a link from broadcasting
create_transit.ponder.transit_ticker.hea: Sharing a network with the Transit Ticker
create_transit.ponder.transit_ticker.tex: One logistics network, with a warehouse of its own
Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
Then mount a link belonging to a second network on top
Order from the parent network as usual
The child network packs it, and the ticker hands it over
Mount a Transit Link instead, and the child becomes foreign territory
create_transit.timetable.bind_first: Set a parking bay first: right-click its train station
create_transit.timetable.bind_hint: Right-click a train station to set the parking bay
create_transit.transit_link.label_hint: The transit label a gate will strip
create_transit.transit_ticker.goggles.cy: Network loops back on itself; this path offers no stock
create_transit.transit_ticker.goggles.di: Child network unreachable: unbound, or its chunks are unloaded
create_transit.transit_ticker.goggles.mo: Stock Link and Transit Link both mounted; transit requests get no stock
item.create_transit.transit_timetable.to: _Donates_ a train to the network: bind its _parking bay_, then hand this to a _conductor_. The dispatcher does the rest.
